intro.uz: Sardor telefonidagi ilovalar haqida gapirib beradi. Oʻqishdan oldin: siz har kuni qaysi ilovalardan foydalanasiz?

paragraphs.en: My name is Sardor. I am sixteen. I have a phone, and there are many apps on it. But I use only four apps a lot.
paragraphs.uz: Mening ismim Sardor. Men oʻn olti yoshdaman. Mening telefonim bor va unda koʻp ilovalar bor. Lekin men faqat toʻrtta ilovadan koʻp foydalanaman.

paragraphs.en: First, I have a music app. I listen to Uzbek and English songs on the bus every morning. Second, I have a dictionary app. It helps me with new English words.
paragraphs.uz: Birinchisi — musiqa ilovasi. Men har kuni ertalab avtobusda oʻzbekcha va inglizcha qoʻshiqlar tinglayman. Ikkinchisi — lugʻat ilovasi. U menga yangi inglizcha soʻzlarni oʻrganishda yordam beradi.

paragraphs.en: Third, I have a map app. When my family goes to a new place, it shows us the way. Fourth, I have a game app, but I only play for thirty minutes a day.
paragraphs.uz: Uchinchisi — xarita ilovasi. Oilam yangi joyga borganda, u bizga yoʻlni koʻrsatadi. Toʻrtinchisi — oʻyin ilovasi, lekin men kuniga faqat oʻttiz daqiqa oʻynayman.

paragraphs.en: At dinner my family doesn't use phones. We put them in a box and talk about our day. I like that too!
paragraphs.uz: Kechki ovqat paytida oilamiz telefonlardan foydalanmaydi. Biz ularni qutiga solib qoʻyamiz va kunimiz haqida gaplashamiz. Bu menga ham yoqadi!

grammar.example: I have a phone, and there are many apps on it.
I listen to Uzbek and English songs on the bus every morning.

questions.statement: There are only four apps on Sardor's phone.

explain.uz: Telefonida koʻp ilova bor: «there are many apps on it». U faqat toʻrttasidan koʻp foydalanadi.

questions.prompt: Where does Sardor listen to music?

explain.uz: «I listen to Uzbek and English songs on the bus every morning.»

questions.prompt: The dictionary app helps Sardor with new English ___.

explain.uz: «It helps me with new English words.»

questions.prompt: Which app shows the family the way?

explain.uz: «I have a map app… it shows us the way.»

questions.statement: Sardor plays games for three hours a day.

explain.uz: Faqat oʻttiz daqiqa: «I only play for thirty minutes a day.»

questions.prompt: At dinner, the family puts their phones in a ___.

explain.uz: «We put them in a box and talk about our day.»

questions.statement: Sardor doesn't like dinner without phones.

explain.uz: Unga bu yoqadi: «I like that too!»
